name: mcp-gauge
stderr:
Usage: mcp-gauge [options] [command]

See exactly which MCP tools are eating your context window.

Options:
  -V, --version          output the version number
  -h, --help             display help for command

Commands:
  init [options]         Install mcp-gauge into your Claude Desktop or Codex
                         config
  uninstall [options]    Remove mcp-gauge and restore your original client
                         config
  proxy [options]        Start the MCP proxy (launched automatically by your MCP
                         client)
  status [options]       Print current token budget to the terminal
  codex-usage [options]  Summarize Codex model and tool usage from local session
                         logs
  telemetry              Manage opt-in anonymous telemetry
  help [command]         display help for command
